statement: Memory inventories at both Samsung and SK Hynix have fallen beneath the 10-day supply threshold.
why: With less than ten days of stock in hand, producers have no buffer to serve incremental AI-server memory orders, so allocation replaces open ordering.

impact.mechanism: Depleted producer inventory makes memory the binding input for GPU-server assembly, raising system cost and slowing accelerator shipments.

evidence.excerpt: On supply: memory inventories at both Samsung and SK Hynix fell 'beneath the 10-day supply threshold.'

confidence.basis: Secondary outlet restating a sell-side figure; no producer filing confirms the inventory level.
